objectives: Tell from a document whether the person who certified it had the power to do so.
Explain the three ways in which a notary can be substituted.
Say which notarial acts a mayor and a Bulgarian consul may perform.
Explain how a notarial document travels abroad (apostille) and how a foreign translation is used in Bulgaria.

cards.front: Who other than a notary may perform notarial functions?
cards.back: Only persons for whom **a law** provides it (Art. 81 ЗННД): assistant notaries, substitutes, registration judges, certain municipal officials and consuls.

cards.front: How does a substitute assistant notary sign?
cards.back: With the addition "**по заместване**" (Art. 46(1) ЗННД); the deed names both the assistant and the notary (Art. 18(3) Наредба № 32).

cards.front: How does another notary substitute a colleague?
cards.back: Under a **contract**, only a notary **from the same district**, for up to **two years**; using the archive of the substituted notary but their own signature and seal (Art. 47 ЗННД).

cards.front: When does the registration judge perform notarial acts?
cards.back: When the district has **no notary**; when nobody substitutes an absent notary (urgent acts); and on documents in the registry archive (Art. 48 and 82 ЗННД).

cards.front: Where may a mayor certify signatures?
cards.back: In a settlement with **no notary and no district court** (Art. 83(1) ЗННД).
Signatures on unilateral private documents not subject to entry; signature **and** content of a power of attorney under Art. 37 ЗЗД; copies (Art. 83(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: What may a mayor NOT certify?
cards.back: Signatures for the transfer of an enterprise or of company shares under Art. 15(1), 129(2) and 137(6) ТЗ (Art. 83(2) ЗННД).

cards.front: In which language must a document be for a Bulgarian consul to certify it?
Who issues the apostille on a Bulgarian notarial certification?
cards.back: The **Ministry of Justice**, within two working days (Art. 17а(2)–(3) ПЛЗП).

cards.front: How is the translation of a foreign document made usable in Bulgaria?
cards.back: The **translator's signature** on the translation is certified by a notary (Art. 21а(1) ПЛЗП).

cards.front: Where do the fees go when a mayor or a registration judge performs a notarial act?
cards.back: Mayor: to the **municipal** budget; registration judge: to the **state** budget (Art. 86 ЗННД).

quiz.question: A deed of sale of a house is signed by "помощник-нотариус" without "по заместване". What is your conclusion?
options: The assistant had no power to issue it; the act is null
The act is valid because the assistant used the notary's seal
The act is valid if the notary was in the office
The act is voidable within three years
quiz.explanation: Real estate deeds are excluded from the powers of an assistant notary who is not a substitute.

quiz.question: Notary A from Plovdiv wants Notary B from Sofia to substitute A for two weeks. Is it possible?
options: No, only a notary from the same district may substitute
Yes, with a contract
Yes, with the consent of the Notary Chamber
Yes, if B is a substitute assistant
quiz.explanation: Substitution by another notary is allowed only within the same district.

quiz.question: What does a substituting notary from the same district put on the documents?
options: Their own signature and seal, and a note of the substitution
The seal of the substituted notary
Only the signature of the substituted notary
The seal of the district court
quiz.explanation: The substitute uses the archive of the substituted notary but signs and seals personally.

quiz.question: A village has no notary and no district court. A resident needs a power of attorney to sell land. What can the mayor do?
options: Certify the signature and the content of the power of attorney
Issue a notarial deed of sale
Nothing; only a notary can help
Certify only the signature, not the content
quiz.explanation: Mayors may certify the signature and content of a power of attorney under Art. 37 ЗЗД.

quiz.question: Which certification may a mayor NOT perform?
options: The signatures on a contract for the transfer of shares in an OOD
The signature on a declaration not subject to entry
The accuracy of a copy
The signature and content of a power of attorney
quiz.explanation: Art. 83(2) excludes the Commerce Act cases.

quiz.question: A Bulgarian citizen in Germany needs a power of attorney in Bulgarian to sell a flat in Varna. Where can the signature and content be certified?
options: At the Bulgarian consulate
Only at a notary in Varna
At any German town hall without anything else
Only at the Bulgarian Ministry of Justice
quiz.explanation: Consuls certify private documents in Bulgarian that are not subject to entry. A German notary with an apostille and a translation is another option.

quiz.question: A Bulgarian notary certified a signature on a document for use in Italy. Who issues the apostille?
options: The Ministry of Justice
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs
The regional governor
The Notary Chamber
quiz.explanation: For notarial acts and official certifications, the Ministry of Justice issues the apostille.

quiz.question: A sworn translator in Sofia translates a Spanish birth certificate for a Bulgarian court. What does a notary certify?
options: The signature of the translator on the translation
The content of the Spanish certificate
The accuracy of the translation
Nothing; the translation is enough
quiz.explanation: Art. 21а(1) ПЛЗП requires notarial certification of the translator's signature.

quiz.question: A district has no notary at all. Who performs notarial acts there?
options: The registration judge at the district court
The mayor of the district centre
The nearest notary from another district
The president of the district court
quiz.explanation: Where there is no notary in the district, the registration judge performs notarial acts.

quiz.question: How long may a substitution by another notary last?
options: Up to two years from the contract
Up to one month
Up to six months
Without limit
quiz.explanation: The term may not be longer than two years from the conclusion of the contract.
